messages:
Priya S.: Quick idea — lunchtime graphic-novel swap? Pick a short rec (single-volume or compact trade) and one sentence why. Could do a 30-min chat next Wednesday.
Carlos M.: Saga vol 1 1 cosmic, funny, adult. Brilliant worldbuilding and fast read. Great for a lively convo. :rocket:
Jenna O'Riley: Daytripper 1 emotional, beautifully drawn. Short and hits hard. Might need tissues. :seedling:
Theo Park: Paper Girls vol 1 1 fun time-travel mystery, nostalgic 90s vibe. Easy to get into.
Rowan T: My Favorite Thing Is Monsters 1 gorgeous art, detective-ish, reads like a long poem. Slightly denser but worth it.
Eliza (contractor): The Killing Joke (Alan Moore) 1 classic, controversial, good for debate around themes. Trigger warning for violence.
Priya S.: Nice spread 1 aim is accessibility — single-volume or <300 pages. If people want heavier fare we can do it as "optional deep-dive" after the lunch.
polly-bot: Poll created: "Which graphic novel for lunchtime swap?" Options: Saga v1 / Daytripper / Paper Girls v1 / My Favorite Thing Is Monsters / Other (reply)
Carlos M.: Voted Saga v1. Also: can we make a shared PDF/scan link? Legal-ish question but for excerpts only.
Jenna O'Riley: Voted Daytripper. I can host and bring snacks (vegan cookies). :cookie:
Theo Park: Voted Paper Girls. Also small ask: can we keep the chat spoiler-free for two days after the session?
Rowan T: Voted My Favorite Thing Is Monsters. Also would love recs for more indie/arthouse stuff afterwards.
Eliza (contractor): Voted Other (Killing Joke) though I'll add a note: content warning slide would be appreciated if we pick it.
Priya S.: Poll closes Tue noon. Plan: if a mainstream-ish pick wins we'll vote on snacks and whether people want a voice call or text chat. If a heavier/trigger-y pick wins, we'll add a brief content note and opt for text-only recap.
Carlos M.: Suggestion: 30-min cap, start at 12:10 so folks can grab food. Quick "favorite panel" share at the end? 1 slide each max.
Jenna O'Riley: Love the "favorite panel" idea. Ill make a Miro board for panels people want to paste.
Priya S.: Thanks! Ill post final details after poll. Totally optional, no pressure. :sparkles:
